answer:
In its testing, Ollama 0.34.1 reduced the response time for a cold `/api/tags` request on a large model library from 3.1 seconds to 294 milliseconds. 

This information is found in the release notes for Ollama 0.34.1:

> "*`/api/tags` is much faster on large model libraries (3.1 s → 294 ms cold in testing), and model capabilities are now reported consistently.*" 

[ollama/v0.34.1.md (lines 1-15)](https://github.com/ollama/ollama/releases/tag/v0.34.1)
